title: Pixel Brief Builder
summary: Plan a tiny game art list before you start drawing.
user: An adult and a child making a tiny game over a weekend.
smallest_useful_product: Choose a genre, palette, character count, and mechanic. Get a 16–24-item checklist, tile template, printable storyboard, and safe asset filenames.
constraints: Create original concepts, avoid copyrighted character references, and collect no children's data.
